summary: Research record for Tirzepatide. Europe PMC indexes 2756 publications, including 131 randomized controlled trials, as of 2026-09-14. Claims are pending human authorship and review.

seo.title: Tirzepatide: what the research shows
seo.description: Cited overview of published Tirzepatide research: 2756 indexed publications, 131 randomized controlled trials. Evidence tier on every claim.

regulatory_status.value: ChEMBL CHEMBL4297839: maximum clinical phase 4, first approval 2022, ATC A10BX16. Jurisdiction-level status pending human review.
